nodes.summary: `gibbsConditional μ Λ` is a version of the conditional probability `μ⟦s | outsideSigma Λ⟧`.
nodes.title: Outside conditional distribution is a version of the conditional probability

nodes.summary: Disintegration in product form: `μ.trim ⊗ₘ gibbsConditional μ Λ` is the law of `(ω, ω)`.
nodes.title: Disintegration in product form for the outside conditional distribution

nodes.summary: Disintegration: averaging the conditional distribution over `μ` gives back `μ`.
nodes.title: Averaging the outside conditional distribution recovers the measure

nodes.summary: The conditional distribution of a finite measure `μ` on `ConfigSpace E` given the configuration outside `Λ`: a regular version of `μ(· | outsideSigma Λ)`, namely Mathlib's `condExpKernel μ (outsideSigma Λ)`. For a Gibbs measure this is the Gibbs specification in `Λ` (DLR condition).
nodes.title: Conditional distribution given the outside of a region

nodes.summary: The outside σ-algebra is a sub-σ-algebra of the product σ-algebra.
nodes.title: Outside σ-algebra is a sub-σ-algebra of the product σ-algebra

nodes.summary: The σ-algebra on `ConfigSpace E` generated by the coordinates outside `Λ`: the information about a configuration that is visible from outside the region `Λ`.
nodes.title: σ-algebra of the configuration outside a region

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
